title: The Interval at Fort Mason
text: The Interval | Fort Mason Center for Arts & Culture Upcoming Events Fort Mason Art Host an Event Visit Donate About Gallery Contact The Interval at Long Now Resident Since 2014 The Interval is a bar-café-museum and home to the Long Now Foundation. Named one of the best bars in America, The Interval features an expansive not-to-be-missed cocktail menu with inspirations from around the globe and throughout time; the on-draft gin and tonics feature local St. George gin and juniper berries from the Sierra Nevada. It hosts The Long Now Foundation’s acclaimed lecture series. The Interval is an inspiring venue for great conversations and delicious drinks. title: The Interval coffee and tea
text: The Interval — LONG NOW Vision Talks Ideas Projects The Interval People Donate Vision Talks Ideas Projects The Interval People Donate The award-winning bar, cafe, community space, and home to The Long Now Foundation. The Interval features craft cocktails, artisan coffee and tea, a chalkboard drawing robot, a library that stretches from floor to ceiling, and exhibits on long-term thinking, all designed to provoke conversation and imagination. Hours & details Private Events Menu 36 Hours in San Francisco “Stop into the only-in-San Francisco Long Now futurist society at the lively Fort Mason Center for Arts & Culture. Part cocktail bar, part science-centric museum to the future, the Interval at Long Now has an eight-foot-tall orrery (a mechanical model of the solar system), artwork by the musician Brian Eno, and bottles of spirits hanging from the ceiling.” 2025 Best of the Bay: Best Cocktail Bar Best of San Francisco: Best Bar and Museum Rolled into One The 32 Essential Cocktail Bars in San Francisco A San Francisco Bar Meant to Last 10,000 Years “Unlike other bars in San Francisco or across the country chasing the idea of what comes next in the immediate sense, The Interval is pursuing something more permanent amidst the ephemeral act of consuming a cocktail after work, which is why classic drinks take precedence. And because drinking here is conceptualized as a wheel in whole landscape of clockwork, it’s allowed the freedom to evolve naturally over the course of time.” Private events Known for our world-class cocktails and striking design, The Interval offers an unforgettable backdrop for your event. As a highly sought-after venue that is open to the public most evenings, private event availability is limited. We do not otherwise accept reservations.
